result.title: Learning Lane-Structured Conditioning Fields for Online HD Mapping
result.summary: High-definition maps provide critical structural information for downstream autonomous driving tasks. Recent methods increasingly rely on external priors to improve prediction accuracy and robustness. Yet, existing prior representations expose a trade-off: dense rasters are easy to integrate but ignore certain map geometric properties, while sparse vectors preserve geometric structure but require dedicated encoders and are difficult to plug into existing architectures. Moreover, external priors can be inaccurate, costly to acquire, or difficult to maintain, motivating a structural representation that can provide geometric guidance while remaining learnable and broadly applicable. We address this limitation with the Lane Field, a dense BEV-aligned geometric representation that encodes local lane structure at each spatial location and can be either predicted from onboard observations or constructed from external map priors. Building on this representation, we introduce a plug-and-play framework that enhances online HD mapping through two complementary mechanisms: BEV feature modulation, which injects lane-structured cues into latent BEV features, and deformable attention guidance, which steers query sampling toward the underlying lane geometry. We primarily evaluate our method on OpenLane-V2, showing that conditioning BEV features and guiding deformable attention with local lane geometry enables our framework to consistently improve existing methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance on lane segment perception. Project page: https://andberto.github.io/LaneField/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Lane Field：一种密集 BEV 对齐的几何表示，在每个空间位置编码局部车道结构，可由车载观测预测或由外部地图先验构建；并给出即插即用框架，通过 BEV 特征调制与可变形注意力引导提升在线 HD 地图构建，在 OpenLane-V2 车道段感知上达到 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把结构化几何先验注入 latent BEV 特征并引导查询采样的做法，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要几何信息如何写入内部状态」以及「先验如何指导 latent 状态生成与证据采样」提供方法线索，需人工核查其调制与注意力引导机制；属远领域工作，非多模态推理主线。
